_comment: Anthropic API list prices (USD per 1M tokens, input/output) — re-grounded 2026-09-04 from platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview.md. Used by derive_cost.api_equiv (the RANKING axis), so a stale figure here silently re-ranks the pool. Cache multipliers are × the input price. SONNET was corrected 2026-09-04: the file carried $3/$15 behind a note saying the $2/$10 introductory rate ran 'through 2026-08-31'; the live page lists Sonnet 5 at $2/$10 with NO expiry, so the rate is current and the old note was four days overdue. ⚠️ KNOWN BLIND SPOT — `_cache.read` is ONE GLOBAL multiplier (0.1× base input) and this table is FAMILY-level, so it cannot express a per-model cache rate. The live footnote reads: 'prompt cache reads cost 10% of the base input price (2.5% on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1)'. So 0.1× is right for Fable 5 ($1.00 on a $10 input) and 4× TOO HIGH for Fable 5.1, whose real rate is $0.25/MTok — and cache reads are 96-98% of real volume, so that is the dominant term, not a rounding error. Fixing it needs per-model rows, not an edited number; sized as plan work. Until then, treat any fable-tier api_equiv as an UPPER BOUND if the tier is running Fable 5.1.
